authority.description: Address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless overwritten).

params.description: Script module parameters to update; all parameters must be supplied.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateParams.title: Msg Update Params
dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateParams.description: MsgUpdateParams updates the module parameters via governance proposal. Behavior: - Validates that the signer has authority to update parameters (gov module). - Validates that all provided parameters are valid. - Updates all module parameters atomically. Validation: - Authority must match the configured authority (gov module account). - All parameters in the params message must pass individual validation. Returns: - empty response on successful parameter update.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.Params.title: Params
dysonprotocol.script.v1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the script module. Historical query-related fields have been removed; this message is currently empty.

dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateParamsR.title: Msg Update Params Response
dysonprotocol.script.v1.MsgUpdateParamsR.description: Empty response indicating successful parameter update.
